[](/mdnahian/trmnlcards/blob/master/doc/images/samplea.jpg) [](/mdnahian/trmnlcards/blob/master/doc/images/sampleb.jpg) Every 5 minutes your reader shows a different high value card. Cards come from every era, from Base Set holos to modern Special Illustration Rares. How it works The reader runs [TRMNL](https://trmnl.com)'s opensource firmware, which turns it into a dashboard: it wakes up, downloads a picture from a server, shows it and goes back to sleep. Instead of TRMNL's own server, you point it at this one, which hands out a different card every 5 minutes. Set up your reader You'll need a computer with Chrome or Edge and a USBC cable. 1. Go to [trmnl.com/flash](https://trmnl.com/flash), choose your model (e.g. X4), plug the reader in and install the firmware. 2. When it restarts, the reader creates a WiFi network called TRMNL. Join it from your phone; a setup page should open. 3. Open Advanced, and set Custom Server to: https://trmnlcards.mdnahian.workers.dev No slash at the end. 4. Pick your home WiFi (it has to be 2.4 GHz), enter the password and save. The first card should appear within a minute. No account or signup needed. Already set up with TRMNL? Hold the power button for about 5 seconds to get back to the WiFi setup page, then follow steps 2–4\. Don't hold it for 15 seconds or more, as that wipes the device's settings. Compatibility Device Status Xteink X4 Works. This is what the photos above show. Xteink X3 Should work. TRMNL has an X3 build and cards are made for its 792×528 screen, but it hasn't been tested. Xteink X4 Pro Unknown. TRMNL doesn't have a separate build for it. Other TRMNL devices Will connect, but get the X4sized image. On screens that stand landscape, cards will look sideways. A few things to know before flashing: The TRMNL firmware replaces the ereader software (stock or CrossPoint). To read books again, flash it back. Cards are shown in black and white. The X4 didn't display 4shade grayscale in testing. The reader connects to WiFi every 5 minutes, so expect to charge it every few days instead of every few weeks. About the cards Prices are TCGplayer market prices for raw (ungraded) cards, refreshed once a week. Graded slabs aren't counted. A card counts at its most valuable printing, so a card with a $1,300 1st Edition counts as $1,300 even if the unlimited copy is cheaper. Card data and scans come from [TCGdex](https://tcgdex.dev). The rotation goes through every card once before repeating, which takes about 5 days. Running your own All of this is in the repo if you'd rather host it yourself or change the settings (price cutoff, darkness, background). server.py runs everything on your own computer: python3 server.py, then point the reader at http://<yourcomputer'sip:2300. Needs Python 3 and Pillow. The hosted version is a Cloudflare Worker (worker/) plus build.py, which a daily GitHub Action runs to fetch prices and upload new cards. Nothing imagerelated is stored in the repo. Settings are environment variables, listed at the top of cards.py, server.py and build.py. Not affiliated with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Xteink or TRMNL. Pokémon card images © Nintendo, Creatures and GAME FREAK. About No description, website, or topics provided. once with an LLM. Then decide on every record forever — classification, scoring, routing — as typesafe JSON with probabilities and confidence, on your own hardware, at zero marginal cost. [](https://pypi.org/project/strotai/) [](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/LICENSE) [](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/tests) [](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/pyproject.toml) [Website](https://strot.ai) · [Docs](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/DEVELOPERS.md) · [Benchmarks](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/benchmarks) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/strotai/) Agents at compile time. Never at runtime. pip install strotai import strot result = strot.run( tickets, query="Triage incoming support tickets into the correct workflow.", action_registry={ "billing_dispute": "Refunds, invoice corrections, double charges", "technical_defect": "Crashes, bugs, broken behavior", }, llm="anthropic/claudeopus48", used once, on first compile only ) for o in result.outcomes: print(o["action"], round(o["confidence"], 2)) billing_dispute 0.97 technical_defect 0.94 The LLM runs once, at compile time. Production is a frozen, selfcontained Python artifact: a small local decision model arbitrates every record, nothing is generated, every output is bounded, and lowconfidence records abstain instead of guessing. STROT = Agentic Schema Intent + Compiler & State + Code + Execution + NLU ⟹ JSON Decisions (classification · scoring · routing · typed answers) How it works COMPILE (once per intent + schema) intent + sample ─▶ synthesize ─▶ golden gate ─▶ teacher labels ─▶ calibrate (labels, (your known (annotate (fit the projection, answers must a sample, confidence handlers) pass) once) threshold) │ ▼ frozen artifact (.py) RUNTIME (every record, forever) record ─▶ projection ─▶ decision model ─▶ confidence gate ─▶ typed JSON (compiled) (144M, CPU, (decide or decision ~60 ms) abstain) Two surfaces run() — route each record to an action and execute the compiled handler. decide() — answer typed questions (choice / score / boolean) per record: result = strot.decide(records, questions={ "is_bug_report": {"type": "boolean", "instructions": "mentions crashes/errors?"}, "customer_sentiment":{"type": "score", "min": 1, "max": 5, "instructions": "1 angry, 5 happy"}, "routing_bucket": {"type": "choice", "options": ["billing", "engineering", "spam"]}, }) → {"booleans": {...}, "scores": {...}, "choices": {...}} with probabilities + confidence Measured Real model (SupersonicLabs/Julia1, 144M, CPU), real datasets, clean Docker containers: Result Grounded routing accuracy (398 records) 92.5% compiled vs 74.8% naive — the compiler is worth +18pp on the same model Semantic text (AG News, unseen labels) 86.7% compiled vs 72.7% naive (+14pp) Typed decisions vs the leading hosted decision API's own example nearidentical (sentiment 1.79 vs 1.8) Latency / marginal cost / LLM calls per record \~60 ms · $0 · 0 Reproduce everything: [benchmarks/](/strotai/ProjectSTROT/blob/main/benchmarks) — with the losses published too. What makes it different Compile once, decide forever — contentaddressed artifact cache; schema drift triggers exactly one recompile. Goldenrecord promotion — artifacts must pass your known answers before they serve. Fitted guarantees — tempe
items.author: solohunter001
items.descZh: STROT是一个开源的决策编译器，背景是解决传统自然语言理解（NLU）运行时依赖持续LLM调用的问题，它通过编译时LLM代码合成实现确定性的自路由运行时。核心功能是允许用户定义意图和模式后，LLM仅在编译时运行一次，生成一个冻结的Python产物，该产物能在运行时对每个记录进行分类、评分和路由决策，输出类型安全的JSON并附带概率和置信度。亮点包括显著性能提升，例如在路由任务上编译版本准确率达92.5%，比naive方法高出18个百分点；语义文本任务准确率达86.7%，提升14个百分点；同时延迟约60毫秒，边际成本为零，且无需运行时LLM调用。适用场景涵盖支持票务分类、情感分析等需要高效、低成本决策的领域，尤其适合对确定性和可重复性要求高的生产环境。
items.quote: 先用 LLM 明确你的意图，然后对每一条记录做出永久性的决定。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Strot – 一次编译 LLM 意图，本地永久运行决策

items.desc: description: Chitra Studio is a native Mac app for AI images, video, voices and music with 60+ models. See every price before you generate. 14day free trial. title: Chitra Studio: AI image, video and music app for Mac image: https://chitra.studio/media/share.jpg Your AI Media Workstation Generate Magic Chitra Studio is a Mac app for generating and managing AI images, videos, voices, music and sound effects using more than 60 models, with documented prompts, references, costs and more. [Download for MacFree · Apple silicon · macOS 15+](download/ChitraStudio.dmg)[14Day Free Trial50 credits included · no card](pricing.html) Free for 14 days with 50 credits to generate with; sign in with your email, no card needed. Then $49 a year, with 50 credits included each year. 01Generate Know the price before you generate. Type a prompt, pick a model, and the cost in credits is on the Generate button before you press it. Change the model, the length or the resolution and it changes with you. A curated list of image and video models from Google, OpenAI, Black Forest Labs, ByteDance, Kling, Alibaba and others. A generation that fails or is refused costs nothing. 02Compare One prompt. Many models. Side by side. Pick two or more models and run the same prompt through all of them. The results fill a contact sheet where you rate, favourite and keep the ones that work. Each result shows its model and what it cost. Video results play in step. A model that fails can be retried by itself. 03Edit Change only what you mark. Draw a box around what should change and say what you want there. Everything outside the box is copied from your original, pixel for pixel. The edit happens on the image you are looking at, and the result takes its place. The original stays in your library, linked to the edit. 04Animate Stills that start moving. Open an image, press Animate and say what should happen. The image waits in place and then plays as a clip. Continue a clip from its last frame to make a longer one. Pull the first or last frame out of any clip as a still. 05Sound Add sound to any clip. Open a clip and press Add Sound. A model watches it and makes the sound for what happens: footsteps, gear, wind, a crowd, or a score timed to its cuts. The clip stays in view while it works, and comes back with its sound. Multiple models for sound effects and music, each with its price shown before it runs. Or lay any sound from your library under a clip, on your Mac, for free. 06Audio Voices, music, any sound. Switch the prompt bar to sound and choose Voice, Music or Sound Effect. Every result lands in your library with its prompt and cost, beside your images and clips. Voices that act out cues like a whisper or a pause, scenes for several speakers, and natural voices in multiple languages. Songs sung to your own lyrics, instrumentals and scores, and effects from a door creak to rain on a roof. 07References One product. Any scene. Save a character, a product, a brand mark, a location or a style once. Attach it to a prompt by name, and the model is told what each reference is for. Keep a reference for one project or for your whole library. A reference can hold several images of the same subject. 08Tools More to do with every result. Every tool shows its model and its price in credits before it runs. Cut Out Lift a subject off its background, automatically or by describing what to keep. Improve Prompt with AI Turn a rough line into a full prompt, with Undo if you preferred your own. Upscale Make an image larger and sharper. Shot Set Reshoot one image from other camera angles. Variation Several takes on an image you like, as close or as bold as you ask. Analyze A review of a result that lists what is wrong and proposes a fix. Clean Up Take background noise and room echo out of a recorded voice. Split into Parts Vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and the rest of a song, each a sound of its own. Pull Out Describe one sound, such as a dog barking, and get it alone and everything else without it. Extend Carry music or an effect on past its end or before its start, keeping its key and space. 09Organise Every prompt and version, documented. Your library is a folder on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded to be stored: back the folder up, move it, or open it in Finder. Each image and clip keeps its prompt, model, settings, references and cost. Projects, ratings, favourites and status, with search across prompts and models. Files from Midjourney, ComfyUI and Automatic1111 come in with the prompts saved inside them. 10Costs See where every credit went. A cost report by day, by model and by project, with a spreadsheet export for quoting and invoicing. Every item shows what it cost, in its details. Improving a prompt and analysing a result are counted too. From the blog [How Chitra Studio compares with Higgsfield, OpenArt, Krea and Freepik/Magnific](blog/chitrastudiovshiggsfieldopenartkreafreepik.html) [Track what AI images and video cost per project](blog/whataimediacosts.html) [Edit part of an AI image without changing the rest](blog/editonepartofanaiimage.html) [Add sound to an AI video](blog/addsoundtoaivideo.html) [All guides](blog/index.html) $49 a year. Pay for what you generate. The app is free to download and to organise your library with. A licence lets you generate, and generations are paid for with Chitra Credits. Try it free for 14 days, with 50 credits Chitra Studio $49 a year, tax included Every model and tool, on every Mac you sign in on. 50 credits with each year's payment. Renews each year until you turn renewal off. Every new account starts with a 14day free trial and 50 credits, no card needed. Chitra Credits from $10 before tax Packs of 1,000 to 11,000 credits. A draft image costs about 1 credit; a spoken line about 1; five seconds of video starts around 35\. Bought credits do not expire, and are spent while your licence is current. items.title: Show HN: Open Artifacts – host AI artifacts on your own Cloudflare account
items.desc: description: Open Artifacts keeps the pages, docs, code and PDFs from any AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) on your own Cloudflare account. title: Open Artifacts: bring any agent, keep every artifact image: https://openartifacts.com/og.png [Skip to content](main) Bring any agent. Keep every artifact. Open Artifacts keeps the pages, docs, code and PDFs from any AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) on your own Cloudflare account. Tell your agent: set up openartifacts.com/llms.txtCopyCopied Set up in three steps 1. \ set up openartifacts.com/llms.txt Tell your agent Your agent reads llms.txt, checks the prerequisites, clones the latest release, and runs pnpm install. 2. Allow Wrangler to manage your account?Allow Sign in to Cloudflare One step needs you: npx wrangler login. Setup then creates D1, R2 and KV and the Access signin app, deploys to both domains, and adds the MCP server to your agent. 3. artifacts.example.com/a/7Hq3…Team Publish and share Your agent publishes a Welcome artifact and gives you the link. Later, ask it to write up the Q4 data migration plan and share it with a teammate. What you get HTML, Markdown, code and PDF Interactive pages, rendered docs, highlighted code and PDFs, viewed in a web dashboard with search. Every version kept Each publish is a new version that records which agent made it. View or restore any of them. Private until you share Share with people by email as viewer or editor, or make a public link that search engines don't index. Live pages An HTML artifact can save and read shared data, so polls, trackers and checklists just work. Any MCP agent Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, ChatGPT, or anything else that speaks MCP. Yours to run MITlicensed, on your own domain, and works on the Workers Free plan. Nothing passes through us. Every publish is a version you can view or restore. Share with people by email, with your team, or by public link. Safe to open Agentwritten HTML runs in a sandboxed frame on a separate, cookieless origin. It can't read your session, call the API as you, or reach the dashboard. Sandboxed Each artifact runs in its own opaque origin, so it can't see the dashboard or other artifacts. No passwords Signin goes through Cloudflare Access with a onetime PIN, GitHub, or Google. Private by default New artifacts are visible only to their creator. Anything you can't see returns a 404, so a link never reveals that it exists. Never indexed Public links send noindex headers, and robots.txt blocks crawlers on both hosts. Revocable tokens Agent tokens are stored only as hashes, and you can revoke them in settings. Open source, MIT licensed Read the code, file an issue, or run it yourself. [View on GitHub](https://github.com/leourbina/openartifacts)
